C-TERMINOLOGY-LANGUAGE-EDITIONS.IntentSummary: Correct the language ownership of the terminology reference through the existing corpus, localization and portal owners.

T-001.Title: Separate and review the language editions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All 71 definitions and applications are complete in each language, with shared naming and equivalent meaning.

T-002.Title: Align governing descriptions, indexes and portal search

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Current descriptions and source selection use separate editions; search results display definitions in the selected language.

T-003.Title: Regenerate and verify both portal routes

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Generated pages, search, language links and layouts show the correct source without fallback; all required checks pass.
